scenes.name: The Hollow Vault
scenes.intro: Pines close over the trail, and the stream runs black between them. East, past the marsh, the vault mouth stands open in the hillside - and the cold coming out of it has never seen the sun.

function.name: Vault Door
function.flavor: An iron-banded vault door seals the eastern chamber. Its lock is ancient — but the tumblers may still turn.

onSuccessWithGood.text: The mechanism yields silently. The way is open.

onSuccessWithBad.text: The door grinds open — far too loudly. Something stirs beyond.

onFailureWithGood.text: The door refuses to budge, but you sense the trick of it now.

onFailureWithBad.text: Your effort echoes like a war drum. The door stays shut.

function.name: Old Wooden Chest
function.flavor: An old wooden chest sits rotting in the corner, its lock crusted with rust.

onSuccessWithGood.text: The lock clicks open smoothly. Inside, treasure glints in the dim light.

onSuccessWithBad.text: The lid creaks open — but the rusted hinge SHRIEKS, echoing down the corridors...

onFailureWithGood.text: The lock holds, but you withdraw your pick before it snaps. You can try again.

onFailureWithBad.text: A needle springs from the lock mechanism and bites your hand. Poison burns.

function.name: Crumbling Pillar
function.flavor: Just past the door, a crumbling pillar leans over the vault floor. One good shove could bring it down.

scenes.name: The Sounding Pit
scenes.intro: The stair gives out into a round chamber. Water moves somewhere below, and the walls carry every sound twice.

function.name: The stair up
function.flavor: The steps you came down. They go back.

function.name: A banded strongbox
function.flavor: Someone left in a hurry, and left this behind.

effects.text: The word you were given does the work for you.

function.lockedText: The lid will not shift. Whatever holds it is not a lock.

lines.text: The carving in the pillar opens its eyes.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Three hundred years, and the first thing through that door is a thief with a lantern.

choices.text: We are not thieves. We came for the vault.
Warden. I know what you are.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: I was left here to keep count. I have counted very carefully.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: The door does not open for the living. It never did. But it might open for the polite.

choices.text: Then let us ask it politely.

onSuccessWithBad.text: It yields — and something deeper in the vault notices.

onFailureWithGood.text: The Warden is unmoved, but not unkind.

onFailureWithBad.text: The eyes narrow. You have been counted.

choices.text: We will find our own way in.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Then you know what I am owed. Ask, and ask well.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Go on, then. Mind the third step; it remembers.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: Travellers! Sit by the fire a while. I have things to sell, if you have coin to spend.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: Take your time. Everything is honest. Mostly. And I buy, too - four in ten of what a thing is worth, which is generous, this far from a town.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: The vault. Folk go in with full purses and come out lighter, or not at all. Either way, somebody needs a draught.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Travellers! Sit, sit. You have the look of people about to do something foolish in that vault.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Anything else, while the fire lasts?

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Wren. I sing for my supper, and Tobin there sells it back to me at a mark-up.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: My songbook. Forty years of verses. I left it in a crate in the vault when the husks came up the stairs. Bring it back and I will pay you for it.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: The crate by the east wall, past the door. Mind the husks, and mind the pages.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Every page! Here - fifteen gold, and Tobin will have it off you soon enough.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Tobin pays four in ten of what a thing is worth, and calls it generous. Sell him what you must, and buy the draughts.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Safe roads, and bring me a story.

items.name: Gold
items.description: Coins, mostly. Some of them are even coins from here.

items.name: The Warden's word
items.description: Not written down anywhere. The door knows it when it hears it.

items.name: Wren's songbook
items.description: Forty years of verses, most of them rude.

quests.name: The Warden's Word
quests.summary: Something in the pillar has kept this vault for three hundred years. It knows a word that opens what is below.

objectives.text: Get the word out of the Warden.
objectives.summary: The Warden gave up its word. Whatever it opens is below, in the pit.

objectives.text: Open the strongbox in the pit.

quests.name: The Lost Verse
quests.summary: Wren the Wandering Bard left her songbook in a crate in the vault when the husks came up the stairs.

objectives.text: Find Wren's songbook in the vault.
objectives.summary: It was in the crate by the east wall, a little chewed.

objectives.text: Bring it back to Wren at the camp.
objectives.summary: Every page. She paid in gold, and in a verse nobody asked for.

cards.name: Hold Fast
cards.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

cards.name: Grapeshot
cards.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

cards.name: Powder and Shot
cards.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

cards.name: Footnote
cards.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

cards.name: Mark the Page
cards.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

cards.name: Another Round
cards.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

cards.name: Barrel Through
cards.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

cards.name: Rally the Line
cards.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

adversaries.name: Merchant
adversaries.description: A pedlar with a cart, a fire and a price for everything.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Sell, haggle, and keep well out of anybody else’s fight.

adversaries.name: Bard
adversaries.description: A travelling singer with a lute, a sharp tongue and a better memory.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Talk, sing, and be somewhere else when the singing stops.

abilities.name: Power Slash
abilities.text: Put your weight behind the swing: deal 2 additional damage.

abilities.name: Iron Stance
abilities.text: While you hold your ground, your Armor Score is higher.

abilities.name: Unbroken
abilities.text: The first Severe blow you take each fight lands as Major instead.

abilities.name: Quick Hands
abilities.text: Your hands are faster than the eye: gain a bonus to action rolls made to palm or plant something.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.text: Against a target unaware of you, your damage roll is higher.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.text: Break line of sight and you are gone until you act again.

abilities.name: Arcane Ward
abilities.text: A shell of warm air holds: raise your Armor Score until your next rest.

abilities.name: Emberbolt
abilities.text: A thrown coal of fire. Your spells deal more damage.

abilities.name: Healing Word
abilities.text: Speak an ally steady: they clear a Stress.

abilities.name: Warding Flame
abilities.text: A ring of low fire. Foes crossing it are struck as they come.

effects.text: Low fire takes in a ring around their feet.

abilities.name: Cinder Burst
abilities.text: Fire blooms: every foe within Very Close of a point takes damage.

effects.text: They choose a spot across the room, and it blooms.

check.prompt: Cinder Burst: one roll, against everything the bloom covers.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.text: Call out: each ally who can hear you clears a Stress.

effects.text: The call carries, and shoulders come up.

abilities.name: Smoke Step
abilities.text: Step from one shadow within Close range to another.

effects.text: They are there, and then they are somewhere else.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: Until your next turn, allies within Melee range gain a bonus to Evasion.

effects.text: A shield comes across, and there is somewhere to stand.

abilities.name: Drilled
abilities.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

abilities.name: Set Feet
abilities.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

abilities.name: Softstep
abilities.text: You are never quite where the eye expects: your Evasion is 1 higher.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

effects.text: They set their feet, and the ground around them stops being neutral.

abilities.name: Emberflow
abilities.text: The heat answers quickly: your spellcast rolls are 1 higher.

conditionDefs.name: Warding Flame
conditionDefs.text: Low fire on the ground: anything that comes through it is struck as it comes.

effects.text: The flame takes them as they come through it.

conditionDefs.name: Behind the Shield
conditionDefs.text: Somebody is holding a shield between you and the room: +1 to your Evasion.

conditionDefs.name: Holding the Line
conditionDefs.text: A stance taken and kept: anything that comes within Very Close is dragged into reach and held there.

conditionDefs.name: Caught
conditionDefs.text: Dragged into reach of the one holding this ground.

effects.text: They come one step too close and are hauled the rest of the way in.

conditionDefs.name: Vulnerable
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Hidden
conditionDefs.text: Any rolls against you have disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Restrained
conditionDefs.text: You can't move until this condition is cleared, but you can still take actions from your current position.

conditionDefs.name: Prone
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage. It ends when you next move: you get up.
